capabilities: display a GitHub-style heatmap of the past year of writing, shaded by characters or notes
count total notes, distinct tags and days since the first note
open a day's daily note by clicking its heatmap cell
filter counted files with glob exclude patterns or a whitelist
show today's note and character count in the status bar
extras: README links to separate Chinese-language documentation. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README warns that file creation times can be rewritten by syncing or restoring, collapsing years of notes onto one day.
motivation: The author wrote it for Chinese notes, where characters rather than words are the usual unit of writing volume.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in visual overview of how much you wrote on each day across the vault.
summary: Sidebar panel that shows a GitHub-style heatmap of daily writing activity alongside vault-wide note, tag and usage-day counters.
